enrichment.headline: Buys $66,878.22 of rubber playground tiles from Sof Surfaces for Allendale Elementary
enrichment.summary: The district is buying rubber tiles from Sof Surfaces, Inc. to cover asphalt and help build the new play structure at Allendale Elementary School. The Board is declaring that public bidding would be futile for this purchase, so the district is buying without a competitive bid. The tiles are due to be delivered by August 30, 2023.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Declaring the Futility of Public Bidding and Awarding A Purchase Order Contract – Sof Surfaces, Inc. – Allendale Elementary School Site Improvements Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Pays Musco Sports Lighting $123,480 to install a mini soccer pitch at Allendale Elementary
enrichment.summary: Musco Sports Lighting will supply and install a modular soccer system at Allendale Elementary School. It includes lighting, fencing, goals, benches, accessible access, lockable storage and a sports tile surface. The Board is declaring that public bidding would be futile, so the district is contracting without a competitive bid. Work is scheduled from August 10, 2023 to February 6, 2024.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Declaring the Futility of Public Bidding - Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Musco Sports Lighting, LLC – Allendale Elementary School Mini-Pitch Purchase and Installation Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Hires G&G Builders for $212,077 to upgrade play areas at Lockwood STEAM Elementary
enrichment.summary: G&G Builders, Inc. will install play surface tiles, remove the existing play structure, and install matting, tetherball poles and basketball hoops at Lockwood STEAM Elementary School. The amount includes a $25,300 contingency (extra money set aside for changes). G&G was the lowest responsive, responsible bidder. Work is expected to run from August 10 to about September 23, 2023.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – G & G Builders, Inc. – Lockwood STEAM Elementary School Site Improvements Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Sets Roots Community Health Clinic's yearly payment at $69,380 for former Parker School space
enrichment.summary: This addendum changes the facilities use agreement for part of the former Parker School, now used by Roots Community Health Clinic. The term runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2028. The annual payment is set at $69,380 for 2024-25, with 5% increases each year after that. All other terms stay the same.

items.group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Addendum, Facilities Use Agreement - A Portion of Former Parker School - Roots Community Health Clinic - Division of Facilities Planning Management

enrichment.headline: Accepts $102,300 from the National Center for Teacher Residencies for Black educator stipends
enrichment.summary: The district is accepting a $102,300 Black Educators Initiative grant through the National Center for Teacher Residencies. The money pays living stipends that support Black educators in the Oakland Teacher Residency Program. The agreement covers July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Award - Black Educators Initiative Contractor Agreement - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Pays Amplify up to $179,802 for reading assessment licenses and training through 2026
enrichment.summary: Amplify Education, Inc. will provide 8,562 licenses for the mClass reading assessments (DIBELS and Lectura) for grades K-2. It will also provide technical support and training for teachers, school leaders and central staff. The agreement runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2026, and the district may spend up to $179,802.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Amplify Education, Inc. - mClass Literacy Tool - Academics and Instruction Department

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $48,800 for Expert Advisors Group conflict resolution trainings, after they began
enrichment.summary: The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) an agreement with Expert Advisors Group LLC to lead trainings on advanced conflict resolution for district members and staff, through the Special Education Department. The service period started April 19, 2023, before this approval, and runs through September 30, 2023. The district may spend up to $48,800.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Expert Advisors Group LLC – Special Education Department

enrichment.headline: Free finishing-trades pre-apprenticeship training from painters' union IUPAT District 16 through 2026
enrichment.summary: The International Union of Painters and Allied Trades (IUPAT) District 16 will provide basic construction and pre-apprenticeship skills training for people who want to join the finishing trades unions, such as drywall finishers, glaziers and painters. It is run through the Adult and Career Education Department at no cost to the district. The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the agreement for July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - No-Cost - The International Union of Painters and Allied Trades (IUPAT) District 16 - Adult and Career Education Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts free classroom instruction videos from Illustrative Math for teacher training
enrichment.summary: Illustrative Math will provide high-quality videos of instructional routines for use in district professional learning, and will build a bank of classroom videos by filming and editing them. This is at no cost to the district. The agreement covers June 20, 2023 through June 30, 2024, and the Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) it.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - No-Cost - Illustrative Math - Academics and Instruction Department

enrichment.headline: Pays AlciDesigns & Consulting up to $13,600 to run Linked Learning events, after work began
enrichment.summary: AlciDesigns & Consulting will plan and run logistics for multiple OUSD College and Career Pathways events. This includes invitations, venues, catering, equipment and marketing materials. The service period started February 23, 2023, before this approval, and ended June 30, 2023. The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the agreement, up to $13,600.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - AlciDesigns & Consulting - High School Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $49,900 for a speech-language pathologist for students
enrichment.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will employ a speech-language pathologist to screen at-risk students and provide speech and language services. This person will also advise school staff and parents and train schools in culturally relevant and linguistically appropriate practices. The agreement runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024, up to $49,900.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
